# bintables/toolchain

> How to build: assemble with nasm, link with ld.

truck [bintables](../bintables.md) · [source](../../../registry/bintables/toolchain.pkg)

The compiler writes the generated source to the file named in
`emit file`, inside a temporary directory, and runs each line of `emit`
there as a command. `{out}` is the absolute path of the executable.
Because the source always has the same name, builds are reproducible.

The output is a static ELF executable with no libc, so `ld` needs no
libraries.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit file`

```nasm
prog.asm
```

### `emit`

```nasm
nasm -f elf64 -o prog.o prog.asm
ld -o {out} prog.o
```
